data.one_liner: Download internet images and media files and save them to device storage.
data.what_it_does: Downloads images and movies from the internet and saves them to the device's photo library on iOS or a specified directory on Android. It preserves EXIF data and GPS coordinates, and provides progress updates and file metadata retrieval.
use_when: You need to save internet images or movies directly to the device storage or photo library
You need to track download progress for media files
avoid_when: You only need to display images in the UI (use cached_network_image instead)
You need a general-purpose HTTP networking library for all REST requests
strengths: Keeps EXIF and GPS data intact
Supports custom directories and progress callbacks
Can open and preview downloaded files immediately
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific permissions setup for Android and iOS
External storage features depend heavily on Android device differences
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription and NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription to Info.plist on iOS, and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission or FileProvider configuration on Android depending on the destination.
